discussion.body: Cael Ward. Male main. Origin Padon, squire paper at Iron's Gate he never finished. Design: FF8 proportion, worn Gate coat, unmarked blade. Cannot die. If a scene would kill him, it knocks him out and spends a main-side life or a Sigil crack instead. Arc: learns the Cannon is not a knight's honor problem; spikes it as a plug. Romance: late, with Liraen only. Suggestive: shared look after WillowDale mist; her hand on the Gate wall in Act 1; one unplayed verse in Valley of Songs; after the seal, two figures on the south road, not a kiss cutscene. Battle: sword, later a Cannon-sigil seal stance. Voice: short sentences. Do not kill, do not marry on screen.
